answer: Deposits are visible in horizon, and tundra reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 48 aliases, and each one needs its own funded trellis account. A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 283 aliases cost 261 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
